protocol.name: cardplay-search-selection-v1
protocol.model_selection: Lowest validation NLL among the three long-SL frozen checkpoints; no test-based seed choice
protocol.selection_rule: Filter by nonforced latency budgets; among positive search means within 0.25 IMP of best, choose lowest mean nonforced latency. Otherwise retain neural
protocol.confirmation: Freeze one configuration before test; compare only that configuration to the fixed neural baseline

runtime.NN_warmup: 3 forwards on a validation board outside the tuning panel; excluded from timing

protocol.uncertainty: 2000 full-deal bootstrap draws; validation intervals are exploratory after configuration selection
protocol.limits: Single frozen SL seed and fixed recorded auction; no strength rating against humans or full WBridge5 engine

selected.reason: Fastest eligible search variant within the predeclared mean-IMP tie band
